title: Rust Modules
learning_objectives: Group related items in inline modules and navigate their paths.
Use visibility modifiers to expose a supported public API while keeping helpers private.
Bring public items into scope with `use` and diagnose visibility or path errors.
explanation: Modules organize a crate into namespaces. Paths identify items, `use` brings a path into scope, and `pub` controls which items outside a module can access. Private helpers can support a small public API without becoming part of that API.

examples.title: Expose a public function
Bring an item into scope
examples.code:
use crate::text_tools::word_count;

let count = word_count("hello Rust");

completion_criteria: Exercise tests pass through the public API without accessing its private helper
Learner can distinguish the helper's definition path from the exported function's access path
Learner can explain why the helper remains private while the API is public
